refnamediv.refpurpose: Creates a pair of connected, indistinguishable socket streams

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
domain
The protocol family to be used: STREAM_PF_INET, STREAM_PF_INET6 or STREAM_PF_UNIX
The values are passed straight to socketpair(2). On Linux, only STREAM_PF_UNIX works: STREAM_PF_INET and STREAM_PF_INET6 fail with Operation not supported.
type
The type of communication to be used: STREAM_SOCK_DGRAM, STREAM_SOCK_RAW, STREAM_SOCK_RDM, STREAM_SOCK_SEQPACKET or STREAM_SOCK_STREAM
On Linux, STREAM_SOCK_STREAM, STREAM_SOCK_DGRAM and STREAM_SOCK_SEQPACKET can be used with STREAM_PF_UNIX, whereas STREAM_SOCK_RDM fails with Protocol not supported.
protocol
The protocol to be used: STREAM_IPPROTO_ICMP, STREAM_IPPROTO_IP, STREAM_IPPROTO_RAW, STREAM_IPPROTO_TCP or STREAM_IPPROTO_UDP
On Linux, STREAM_PF_UNIX accepts STREAM_IPPROTO_IP, which should be used. STREAM_IPPROTO_TCP, STREAM_IPPROTO_UDP and STREAM_IPPROTO_RAW fail with Protocol not supported. STREAM_IPPROTO_ICMP only works because its value is the same as STREAM_PF_UNIX.
Please consult the Streams constant list for further details on each constant.
